After Kb7, White plays Rxc5, still winning the knight cleanly. This is clearly the best move - it wins material by force.

**Best move:** Rxc6+

**Main line:** Rxc6+ Kb8 (or Kd7, Kb7) Rxc5, White is up a knight.

**Motif:** fork (the rook forks the king and knight)

**Coaching note:**

When your pieces are attacked (loose), look for forcing moves first. Here both your rook and queen were hanging to the Nc5. The key was noticing the check with **Rxc6+**—the rook forks king and knight. Black must respond to check, and after moving the king, you simply capture the undefended knight on c5 with Rxc5, winning material by force. Always scan for checks that win material; they're harder for opponents to defend.
